1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Had Laju (Tanjakan Jalan

Cheras (Timur)) 2022.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 10 Mac 2022.

Larangan

2. (1) Pemanduan kenderaan motor dengan kelajuan yang lebih daripada

kelajuan yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (2) Jadual Pertama di atas jalan yang dinyatakan

dalam ruang (1) Jadual Pertama dilarang.

(2) Jalan dengan had laju yang dinyatakan dalam subperenggan (1)

ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual Kedua.

Menteri Kanan Kerja Raya

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

SPEED LIMIT (JALAN CHERAS (EAST) RAMP) ORDER 2022

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 69(2) of the

Road Transport Act 1987 [Act 333], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Speed Limit (Jalan Cheras (East) Ramp)

Order 2022.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 10 March 2022.

Prohibition

2. (1) The driving of motor vehicles at a speed greater than the speed specified in

column (2) of the First Schedule on the road specified in column (1) of the First Schedule

is prohibited.

(2) The road with speed limit specified in subparagraph (1) is shown on map

in the Second Schedule.

FIRST SCHEDULE

[Subparagraph 2(1)]

(1)

Road

(2)

Speed limit

(km/h)

The part of the road known as Jalan Cheras (East) Ramp

which is part of Sungai Besi Highway commencing from

coordinate N 345478.104, E 414512.830 and ending at

Limit of Maintenance Responsibility, Jalan Cheras at

coordinate N 345585.449, E 414667.268
